description: Find shared working-hour windows for two to 20 places. Customize local working hours and meeting duration, or search up to 14 additional days for the first suitable date. Returns answer_url, a link to a page showing this answer live, to include in your reply.

date.description: Starting calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD format, interpreted in the first place. Defaults to today there.

days_ahead.description: Additional calendar days to search after date, from 0 to 14. Defaults to 0. Stops at the first date with a suitable window; weekends are included.

duration_minutes.description: Minimum shared window length in whole minutes, from 15 to 480. Defaults to 30.

places.description: Two to 20 participant cities, IANA time zones, supported abbreviations or UTC offsets. The first place defines the search calendar date.

work_end.description: Daily working-hours end in 24-hour HH:mm format, local to each participant. Defaults to 17:00 and must be after work_start; overnight ranges are not supported.

work_start.description: Daily working-hours start in 24-hour HH:mm format, local to each participant. Defaults to 09:00.

name: find_meeting_times

answer_link_markdown.description: A ready-made Markdown link to show the user. Translate the link text to the user's language if needed.

answer_url.description: Link to a page that shows this exact answer live. Include it in your reply to the user.

board_url.description: Link to the personal time-zone board with the answer items temporarily requested.

title: Find meeting times
